strategy.reason: Block_reassign can move a short run of duties off a nurse to create/extend required consecutive OFF blocks (especially for min_consec_off=3 nurses) and can also help reduce weekend overages by relocating weekend duties, while being less prone than block_swap to create illegal_succession through cross-nurse shift-type exchanges.
strategy.avoid: Avoid block_swap (recently caused illegal_succession spikes) and avoid coverage_fill since it risks worsening max_total/weekend pressure and previously produced mostly non-improving candidates.
